Voiczy: Language Learning App for Kids — Ages 3 to 14, 19 Languages

# Watch your child speak a new language.

Voiczy is the safe, ad-free language learning app for kids ages 3 to 14. Choose from 19 languages — your child learns by listening, speaking, and reading along.

See Voiczy in 60 seconds

Leo¡Perfecto!

New word learned!

19 languages, one calm app

## Pick a language to start.

Start with one, or wander through them all — every language is included from day one.

Dutch French Polish German Italian Brazilian Portuguese Chinese English Finnish Turkish Arabic Danish Hindi Japanese Korean Norwegian Persian Portuguese Spanish Swedish

## From first words to real conversations.

Everything your child needs to learn a new language, all in one calm app.

### Real talking, real progress.

Leo is a kid-safe tutor your child actually speaks with — out loud, in real time. Natural back-and-forth conversations build confidence, using words they already know, with no pressure and no judgment.

Leo LIVE VOICE · 0:38

Listening… just talk to Leo “¡Hola Leo, estoy bien!”

### Read along, listen along.

Real picture books that read aloud in two languages at once — the new language your child is learning, with help in the one they already know. A reading habit and a new language, at the same time.

Audio books for kids Voiczy

The Cat and the Moon Picture book · 4 min

Spanish English

### Learn through play.

Vocabulary games connect new words to pictures and to words your child already knows. A fun, fast way to learn — and to actually remember.

Match the word 12 of 15 correct

Today's words

 Parent dashboard

### Safe, ad-free, in your control.

Set daily time limits, choose which features your child can use, and see clear activity reports. Manage all your kids from one calm place.

10 min daily limit Today: 6 min used 3 child profiles Lucía · Mateo · Sofia 0 ads Always — on every screen

## Not just tapping. Real speaking.

The same way they learned their first: listen first, then speak out loud.

Linking language. Children learn a new language fastest through the one they already know. So we teach in both at once — every new word anchored to a word they own.

## Researched with care. Tested on our own kids.

“We wanted our children to learn the way kids naturally pick up a language — by listening and speaking — but most apps just kept them tapping. So we built the one we couldn't find.”

A method that mirrors real life

The natural immersion approach — listen first, then speak — not slot-machine game loops.

Speaking from day one

Children talk out loud and build genuine confidence — the way they learned their first language at home.

Made for real families

If it isn't good enough for our own children, it doesn't make it into the app.

## Screen time parents feel good about

Many kids apps use flashing lights, loud sounds, and constant rewards to keep children hooked. Voiczy is built for calm, focused learning. 15 minutes a day is enough.

No stress

## Built by Expat Parents. Tested on Our Own Kids.

“We couldn't find a tool that taught our children to actually speak. So we built one.”

### The Expat Reality

Moving to a new country is hard. We built Voiczy because the existing apps weren't helping our kids make friends or speak with confidence.

### Science, Not Gimmicks

We swapped addictive slot-machine mechanics for immersion techniques used by international schools.

If it wasn't good enough for our own children, it didn't make it into the app.

Parent-Founded
